title: Mixed Event — My Color! — Episode4 To Put on Airs

meta.Event Outline: The MORE MORE JUMP! livestream kicks off to a great start! Things are going smoothly, until Shizuku's fear becomes a reality. Shizuku must reevaluate her past and present self in order to arrive at her ultimate decision.

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm so sorry, everyone.
Our livestream was a disaster because of me...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, it's not your fault, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Just look at your dancing! You were perfect!
Your conversation was interesting too as usual...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: As usual...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But my usual self isn't good enough...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm sorry I wasn't able to support you like I said I would, Shizuku. I guess it's not as easy as I thought...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I should've been more mindful of just how strong your Cheerful*Days image still is...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What do you mean by that?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: My fans still have the same impression of me from when I was in Cheerful*Days.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Which is what, exactly...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The beautiful idol who can do anything. The one everyone looks up to. That's the Shizuku Hinomori of Cheerful*Days.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So many people put in a lot of effort to help me maintain that image.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: They gave me acting lessons, edited my videos...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I was taught how to be the perfect idol in front of my fans.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The fans who have been supporting me since my time in Cheerful*Days are expecting to see that version of me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Which is why...
I'm not supposed to ruin that image.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm not supposed to be my usual self.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm so sorry, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Please... Don't apologize, Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Airi and I also have public images that were cultivated with our previous groups.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So there's likely going to be a gap in the way our fans see us now, but there isn't really much we can do about that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's why I figured it would be for the best if we could try to establish a new image little by little as MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I didn't expect your fans' perception of you to be so stuck in stone...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This is just as much my fault for not properly taking these sorts of risks into account when we were planning things out...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're gonna have to come up with some way of dealing with this...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: When you were in Cheerful*Days, your agency and the television staff were the ones who decided what your image would be, right?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. Whenever I said something that didn't quite match the image they wanted me to have, they would edit it out of the final cut.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I even had scripts for concerts, and they also made it so the other members would do most of the talking.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Having the rest of us do the talking would be difficult. It works for a big group like Cheerful*Days, but it'd feel wrong if we tried doing it with only the four of us.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But video editing might be doable...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I've never tried it before, so I doubt I can do as good a job as a professional, but I'll learn what I can before our next video.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But if we do that, it'll mean no more livestreams...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (If we edit each video, we may be able to protect my image...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But that also limits the ways MORE MORE JUMP! can reach its fans.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Of course, we can still reach plenty of fans even without doing livestreams but...)

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<I wanna see your dance practice!>
<I can't wait!>
<Good luck!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I feel like the current plan is the best way to spread hope and show the fans who we are now.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (So... I have to make a decision.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Protect the fans' image of Shizuku Hinomori, or go with MORE MORE JUMP!'s best option for spreading hope to the fans...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm sorry...
May I have some time to think this over?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I... I promise to find the answer.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Of course. We'll be waiting...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shizuku...
